findings.message: User task "Prepare Documents" is a job-worker user task; Camunda 8.8 deprecates those in favour of Camunda user tasks.
findings.suggestion: Add zeebe:userTask to make it a Camunda user task.

findings.message: User task "Prepare Documents" has no zeebe:formDefinition.
findings.suggestion: Link a form (formId), an external form, or an embedded form.
